tools.name: search_devices
tools.description: Full-text search of the DevicErts catalogue (EUDAMED, FDA 510(k), De Novo, PMA, GUDID). Returns up to 20 devices, each with its page URL, manufacturer, risk class, registries, headline status, primary reference and UDI-DI. tools.description: Exact lookup of a regulatory identifier: 510(k), PMA or De Novo number, UDI-DI or EU Basic UDI-DI. tools.name: search_manufacturers
tools.description: Search medical device manufacturers by name. Returns up to 20 companies with their DevicErts page URL, slug and country.

tools.name: get_manufacturer
tools.description: The DevicErts record of one manufacturer: name and registered names, country with its basis, registry identifiers (EUDAMED SRN, FDA FEI, DUNS), device counts per registry and risk class, up to 10 of its devices, EU certificates and recent FDA recalls matched to it.

tools.name: get_data_sources
tools.description: The registries DevicErts compiles (EUDAMED, FDA GUDID, 510(k), De Novo, PMA, recalls, establishment registrations): region, number of records in the catalogue, last sync date, sync cadence and reuse terms of each, plus the catalogue totals.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Standard search tool: finds medical devices in the DevicErts catalogue and returns up to 10 results as id, title and url. The id goes to fetch.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Standard fetch tool: the full record behind a search result id (device:<slug> or manufacturer:<slug>) as Markdown text, with its canonical url and metadata (registries, retrieval date, reuse terms).

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_device" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
